title: ‘Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle’ opens to $70M, biggest anime debut to claim top box-office spot
summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — “Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba _ Infinity Castle” carved out a place in box-office history this weekend as the Japanese anime film sliced straight to No. 1 _ outpacing the horror sequel “The Conjuring: Last Rites.” The Sony-owned Crunchyroll release shattered expectations with a mighty $70 million debut in North America, […]
